description: Source code for the MainActivity class in an Android implementation of a Tic-Tac-Toe game. The file manages game state, UI interactions, and user input handling, including updating the board, detecting wins or draws, and resetting the game.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity class for the Tic-Tac-Toe game, handling UI setup, game logic, and user interactions.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI for a new game, initializing variables, clearing the board, and updating UI elements.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles cell tap events, updating game state, checking for win/draw, and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: lockBoard
methods.description: Disables further input after game conclusion.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning combinations for a winner.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks whether the game has resulted in a draw.

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates UI to show current player.

methods.name: applyMarkStyling
methods.description: Styles a cell button according to the mark ('X' or 'O').
